title: Battle of Kadesh
summary: In 1274 BCE, Egyptian forces under Pharaoh Ramesses II clashed with King Muwatalli II's Hittite army near the fortress of Kadesh on the Orontes River. After a massive chariot ambush and fierce fighting ended in a tactical stalemate, the prolonged rivalry culminated decades later in the 1258 BCE Egyptian-Hittite peace treaty, the earliest surviving international peace accord.

uncertainty.note: Conventionally dated to 1274 BCE (regnal year 5 of Ramesses II); chronologies range between 1275 and 1274 BCE.
